exposure: stress coping styles (optimistic approach, desperate approach, applying for social support)
outcome: preferences regarding mode of delivery (normal vaginal delivery, cesarean section)
cohort: The study included 548 female university students studying at a health science faculty in Turkey.
finding: Female students demonstrating an optimistic approach were more likely to prefer vaginal delivery, while those with a desperate approach showed a higher preference for cesarean section.
mod_finding: Female students exhibiting an optimistic approach to stress coping were more likely to prefer vaginal delivery, while those with a desperate approach preferred cesarean section.
